Dear Mr. Upton,

Re: Account reference: ACC-600149

We acknowledge receipt of your dispute regarding the accuracy of the amount owed on your account. We understand that you have requested an investigation into the account, citing your rights under the Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA), specifically 15 USC 1681e(b) and 15 USC 1681i.

We have reviewed the information on file, and we confirm that the current balance on your account is $20,370.53. We also confirm that the account was charged off on May 8, 2022, and your last payment was received on March 28, 2023.

Pursuant to the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), we are required to investigate your dispute and provide you with a written validation of the debt if our investigation confirms the debt. We will conduct a thorough review of the account to verify the accuracy of the amount owed.

Please note that, as per the FDCPA, we are not required to remove the account from your credit report if our investigation confirms the debt. However, we will provide you with a written validation of the debt, which will include the amount owed, the original creditor, and any other relevant information.

You have the right to further dispute the debt if you believe our investigation does not accurately reflect the amount owed. If you wish to continue disputing the debt, please respond to this letter within 30 days.

Sincerely,

Keystone Account Solutions
